items.description: Laptop damage payment - cracked screen and lower-right corner damage
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (thrown against fixed interior of conveyance during evasive turn); both damage areas are one loss per 2.6.3. Repair cost (screen ~800 + corner ~350) capped under 7.1.10 at the acquisition price of an equivalent new unit, EUR 1,400; no deductible or sub-limit stated.
